description: This Scala source file defines the SparkSubmitArguments class, which parses and encapsulates command-line arguments for the spark-submit script in Apache Spark. It handles argument parsing, configuration loading, validation, and provides utility methods related to Spark submission.

classes.name: SparkSubmitArguments
classes.description: A class that parses command-line arguments for spark-submit, manages configuration properties, and provides validation and utility functions for Spark job submission.

methods.name: loadPropertiesFromFile
methods.description: Loads properties from a specified file into the sparkProperties map.

methods.name: mergeDefaultSparkProperties
methods.description: Merges properties from default and additional properties files, respecting priority rules.

methods.name: ignoreNonSparkProperties
methods.description: Removes properties that do not start with 'spark.' from sparkProperties.

methods.name: loadEnvironmentArguments
methods.description: Loads argument values from environment variables, system properties, and sparkProperties.

methods.name: validateArguments
methods.description: Validates the parsed arguments based on the action (submit, kill, status).

methods.name: validateSubmitArguments
methods.description: Performs validation specific to spark-submit action.

methods.name: validateStatusRequestArguments
methods.description: Performs validation for status request action.

methods.name: toSparkConf
methods.description: Converts the parsed properties into a SparkConf object.
